  WHY: A repeated comment-post failure leaves the cycle budget unconsumed and can prevent the PR from reaching exhaustion; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this NIT, while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.

- requirement: "Once the cycles are used up, the PR is labelled `ai:security-pass-failed`"

- requirement: “Count each failed dispatch as a used cycle.” The gate should record a failed marker and, once the configured cycle limit is used, reach the existing exhaustion path.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh, single_pass_gate dispatch-failure handling

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:512-513 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: When the exhausted_retry path hits a dispatch failure, it logs and holds but writes no marker, so head_attempts never advances and the loop repeats indefinitely.
  WHY: No marker records this attempt, so head_attempts stays at 0, exhausted_retry stays true, and the PR is held indefinitely with no escape.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:523-524 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: When the gh api call to post the failed-cycle marker fails, the code warns and continues without consuming a cycle.
  WHY: This is a deliberate fail-open pattern; the warning documents that the cycle is not recorded and the next review run retries.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "On dispatch failure, write hold=true and leave auto-merge blocked; retry dispatch on a later review run rather than treating failure as a security-pass skip."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh
  Evidence of absence: The requirement is implemented in the non-exhausted dispatch-failure branch (lines 514-529): hold=true with hold_reason=dispatch_failed, a failed marker records the cycle, and later review runs retry. The exhausted_retry dispatch-failure branch (lines 512-513) also holds but does not record the attempt, which creates a correctness gap (reported above under CORRECTNESS) rather than a missing requirement. The core fix matches the issue specification.
  severity=low | confidence=[2]

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:523-524 | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: When gh api fails to post the failed-cycle marker, no marker records the attempt and the next review run recomputes the same next_cycle.
  WHY: Repeated marker-post failures leave cycles_used unchanged, so the PR is held indefinitely without reaching the label path.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:457-464 | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: With only failed markers, head_attempts remains below exhausted_head_limit after cycles_used reaches effective_max, so exhausted_retry stays true and the ai:security-pass-failed label is never written.
  WHY: Execution falls through to retry dispatch instead of applying the exhaustion label; test_exhausted_retry_dispatch_failure_holds pins this fall-through behavior.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Once the cycles are used up, the PR is labelled `ai:security-pass-failed`" (changelog.d/6213-single-issue-security-pass-dispatch-failure-holds.md line 3, repeated verbatim in the new comment body at scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:520).
  Expected change site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh dispatch-failure branch (lines 510-530) and the cycle-exhaustion block (lines 457-504) that owns the `ai:security-pass-failed` label write.
  Evidence of absence: When dispatch keeps failing (e.g., a consumer wrapper that does not accept `pr_number`), every run takes the new branch at line 514 and posts a `failed` marker, so `markers` accumulates `status=failed` rows whose cycle number advances cycles_used each iteration. After 5 such failed markers, `cycles_used` (=5) meets `effective_max` (=5) at line 457, but the inner check at lines 458-462 sets `exhausted_retry=true` whenever `completed_findings` is empty AND `head_attempts < exhausted_head_limit`. `head_attempts` (line 459) counts only `status == "pending"` markers with cycle > cap, so a head whose only markers are failed yields `head_attempts=0 < 2` and `exhausted_retry=true`. The label-application branch at line 464 (`if [ "${exhausted_retry}" != "true" ]`) is therefore skipped, and execution falls through to line 505, computes `next_cycle=cycles_used+1`, and re-tries the dispatch — which fails again. The label `ai:security-pass-failed` is never written. PR #6213's own test `test_exhausted_retry_dispatch_failure_holds` (tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:584-587) pins this fall-through behavior with `reason=dispatch_failed_exhausted` and asserts another dispatch is attempted, so the regression is locked in by the new tests. The four new tests added in this PR also do not exercise the case where a failed-marker-only PR reaches `cycles_used >= effective_max`: the closest case (`test_repeated_dispatch_failures_record_each_cycle`, lines 575-581) starts with only 4 prior failed markers (cycles_used=4 < effective_max=5) and verifies the 5th post succeeds.
  severity=high | confidence=[5]
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:457-462 and 512-514 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: When the cycle limit is reached without a completed audit, a retry dispatch failure writes no marker, so head_attempts remains unchanged.
  WHY: Every later review run sees the same head_attempts value and retries the dispatch; the bounded retry path never reaches the exhaustion handling that labels the PR ai:security-pass-failed.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:523-529 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: If posting the failed-cycle comment fails, the code only warns, then writes hold=true and returns success without recording the failed cycle.
  WHY: The next review reads unchanged comments, calculates the same cycles_used, and retries that cycle; repeated comment-write failures prevent failed dispatches from consuming the configured cycle budget.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “Count each failed dispatch as a used cycle.” The gate should record a failed marker and, once the configured cycle limit is used, reach the existing exhaustion path.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh, single_pass_gate dispatch-failure handling.
  Evidence of absence: The below-limit path only records the marker on a successful comment POST (lines 523-524), while the exhausted-retry path records no failed marker at all (lines 512-514). In either case, a failed dispatch can leave the state unchanged, so subsequent review runs do not reliably advance toward exhaustion.
  severity=high | confidence=[5]
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
